analysis_plan.interval_method: paired task-cluster percentile bootstrap, descriptive only; boundary and undefined draws explicitly reported
analysis_plan.precision_position: sample is for feasibility and estimates; not designed to establish the ten-point completion margin or joint economic target
analysis_plan.degenerate_intervals: report uninformative and show paired task outcomes; no precision certificate
analysis_plan.zero_acceptance_resamples: cost ratio undefined/unbounded; report proportion, never discard silently
analysis_plan.incomplete_planned_sample: report stage-specific feasibility estimates and missingness sensitivity
analysis_plan.capped_delivery_time: accepted submission time, otherwise registered T

stopping_rule.scope: entire agent/supervisor workflow including tools, waits, retries and worker handoffs
stopping_rule.account_exhaustion_action: stop new dispatch globally; preserve active attempts, incomplete blocks and missingness
stopping_rule.deadline_basis: fixed uniform practical cutoff selected before calibration; no pooled accepted-runtime median

calibration_timeout_review.action: pause before scoring; review scope/cutoff validity and preregister new calibration if redesigned; never extend selected arms or erase failures

criteria: native usage captured for at least 95 percent of completed calls with all missing calls listed
remaining tasks can be qualified without access to prior outcomes
optional human-review staffing does not gate core continuation

retry_control.selection: first trusted-public-passing eligible candidate in preregistered order

pricing_rule.primary: frozen uncached API-equivalent input/output list prices

pricing_rule.missing_usage_policy: unresolved unless decision-valid bounds are available

human_review.repair_work: separate repair extension; never silently repair original endpoints

provider_qualification.precision_choice: Prefer tested ZDR BF16 Gemma candidate over FP4 before calibration; no model ID substitution
provider_qualification.if_BF16_unavailable: pause; register/requalify explicit alternative (FP8 preferred, FP4 must be labeled as served at FP4); do not pool configurations

glm_relace_fp4.interpretation: completion-only reproduces this bill exactly; not evidence that reasoning is a subset of completion or of physically separate chargeable tokens
glm_relace_fp4.native_OpenCode_output_caveat: OpenCode subtracts reasoning and clamps output at zero; when reasoning exceeds completion, output+reasoning overcounts billed output. Never reconstruct billed output from that split.
glm_relace_fp4.authoritative_billing_source: captured raw gateway/provider usage.completion_tokens, cross-checked against provider cost; preserve OpenCode native fields separately

execution_schedule.reserve: remaining CPU/memory for controller and separately limited evaluator; no competing interactive build jobs
execution_schedule.qualification: replay same generic/public mechanical commands alone and with both lanes loaded; median duration inflation <=10%, no OOM/throttling/unaccounted swap or transport rate-limit drift; same limits in sequential qualification
execution_schedule.if_qualification_fails: amend to sequential before calibration; preserve failed qualification; no silent mixed scheduling
execution_schedule.assignment: seeded balanced lane and time-block assignment across arms/tasks; preserve paired blocks; do not run all of one model first
execution_schedule.portfolio: physical collection may overlap; report registered sequential retry-policy opportunity as sum of candidate durations, not minimum parallel latency
execution_schedule.provider_drift_checks: verify catalog revision/tag/quantization before each dispatch and generation resolution after each call; stop new dispatch on drift and record affected runs; resume as separately registered cohort, never pool silently
execution_schedule.opaque_provider_drift_limit: unchanged public IDs cannot prove immutable hidden serving weights/settings

collection_forecast.excludes: fixture/reference/negative-control/corpus construction, independent qualification, outages, provider requalification and optional human review
collection_forecast.reforecast: after first technical block and calibration using actual endpoint runtimes, timeout rates and setup/evaluation overhead; preserve forecast history; no outcome-based sample changes

setup_model_policy.scope: all future study and setup model calls unless user explicitly revises this restriction
setup_model_policy.prior_unscored_availability_probes: setup/status.json; excluded from study results, recorded as setup overhead
setup_model_policy.interactive_coordinator: existing chat is coordination only; launched builder/reviewer/subject models restricted to the three allowlisted IDs

disposable_database_authorization.basis: user directs execution of the approved setup steps for the new application with disposable local test database
disposable_database_authorization.scope: new isolated study fixture and evaluator SQLite files only
